records.issue: General prose emphasizes same overall blocks; design 3 explicitly has fewer cells and is smaller.
records.handling: Use design-specific identity and dimensions; never reuse M1 envelope for M3.

records.issue: Main cites Fig S3 for the depth-phase relationship; S3 is force-model validation and S4 contains the depth-phase plot.
records.handling: Preserve both original locator and corrected review locator; no silent publisher correction.

records.issue: Text cites Fig1d for transmission, but the published figure has panels a-c and transmission appears within c.
records.handling: Flag the reference mismatch; do not invent a panel or experimental transmission arm.

records.issue: Captions call bars standard deviation; Methods also calls plus/minus one sigma a confidence interval. Sample n is absent.
records.handling: Record stated SD only, no confidence level, SEM, or inferred n.

records.issue: The torsion formula uses arm length while Methods gives an 18 cm rod; the effective lever is not explicitly resolved.
records.handling: Require facility geometry and calibration; no adopted half-length assumption.

records.issue: Screen spot subtraction is described as yielding metasurface displacement, without the full optical transfer calibration.
records.handling: Preserve raw pixels/screen units separately; refuse uncalibrated physical displacement and force.

records.issue: In the displayed dual-axis trace, positive source-angle steps correspond to negative displacement trends; prose describes following.
records.handling: Treat as unresolved coordinate convention, not proof of contradicted physics; require sign-tested coordinate transform.

records.issue: All experiments state 8 cm; self-guiding simulation states 12 cm for visualizing scattering.
records.handling: This is an explicit source distinction, not an error. Keep separate lineage and do not call the configurations matched.
